user.title: Parental Control
user.description: Choose the switch to control. This integration was originally written for the parental control switches from the ha-glinet-router GL.iNet integration, but it works with any Home Assistant switch.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this schedule (for example a child's name).
data_description.switch_entity_id: Switch that will be turned off during the allowed window.
data_description.invert: Enable this if the target switch must be turned on (instead of off) during the allowed window.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: For each weekday, enable a time window during which the parental control switch is automatically turned off. Outside that window the switch is turned back on. If the start time is later than the end time, the window continues after midnight.

error.invalid_period: Start and end must be different when the day is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This switch already has a parental control schedule.
